items.title: Lough Neagh Network Contribution
items.subtitle: Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs / Open Data NI / Browse/Tables plus Sources
provider: Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs
items.description:
Open data dataset published on Open Data NI (opendatani.gov.uk) by Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs, licensed UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Catalogue reference record; the data is served from Open Data NI.

About this layer

Network contribution area scores were exported from the SciMAP application outputs within SAGA GIS. The scores were based on inputs from CEH Land cover 2007, Met Office average rainfall and 5 meter DTM. The High contribution category boundary was determined by selecting +1 standard deviation of the distribution of the scores.

items.subtitle: Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs / Open Data NI / Browse/Tables plus Sources

items.description:
Open data dataset published on Open Data NI (opendatani.gov.uk) by Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs, licensed UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Catalogue reference record; the data is served from Open Data NI.

The field probe has been deployed by NIEA’s Freshwater Monitoring and Assessment team as part of a long term, high frequency water quality monitoring project.  It records Dissolved Oxygen (%Saturation) and temperature (°C) in the Maine River downstream of the M2 Bridge.

Catalogue reference record; the data is served from Open Data NI. Air pollution results from the introduction of a range of substances into the atmosphere from a wide variety of sources.
